reason: I might use the 40 free documents to see what it catches, but I wouldn't pay yet. Most of what I pay mechanics is cash with a scribbled nota or nothing, and catching a duplicate photo doesn't stop someone writing a higher price on a fresh nota, which is how I actually got cheated.
objection: It's a new little bot nobody I know uses. If it disappears in six months, my records are stuck halfway, and it can't tell whether a part really cost what the receipt says.
would_change_my_mind: Another scooter or shop owner in Bali showing me it caught real padded or repeated claims from their staff over a few months, plus proof the bot has been running for a while.
